Name: Reforged - Combat Buddies (Trinkets)
Author: BitByDit
Description:
[b][center][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/aWQtXd3.gif[/img][/size][size=3]
[/size]
[font=Arial][size=5]DESCRIPTION[/size][/font]
[size=3]────────────[/size][size=3]✧[/size][size=3]──────[/size][size=3]──────[/size][/center][/b][font=Arial][size=3]Brings your loyal [b]companions[/b] to life with a [b]complete visual overhaul[/b]—every [b]Frog[/b], [b]Parrot[/b], and [b]Fairy[/b] has been [b]carefully redrawn[/b] to be [b]more expressive[/b], [b]detailed[/b], and [b]charming[/b], all while [b]staying[/b] [b]true to the classic Stardew Valley aesthetic[/b]. Whether they're helping you in the mines or keeping you company on the farm, [b][color=#e69138]Reforged - Combat Buddies[/color][/b] ensures your combat buddies look [b]fresh[/b], [b]vibrant[/b], and perfectly at home in the valley you love![/size][/font]


[b][center][size=5][font=Arial]FEATURES[/font]
[/size][size=3]────────────[/size][size=3]✧[/size][size=3]──────[/size][size=3]──────[/size][/center][/b][size=3]Give your loyal companions the [b]makeover[/b] they deserve! This mod refreshes every Frog, Parrot, and Fairy with [b]detailed new textures[/b] that [b]stay true to Stardew Valley's classic charm[/b]. [b]Fresh[/b], [b]faithful[/b], and [b]more customizable[/b] than ever![/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V1GQi2w.png[/img]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/GgXNU1o.gif[/img]
[size=3]Your hungry companion receives a [b]complete visual refresh. [/b]Every detail has been carefully redrawn to be [b]sharper[/b] and [b]more charming[/b] while preserving its original vanilla soul. Even better, each frog now looks [b]more unique based on its color rarity[/b], so your rarest catches will truly stand out![/size][/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/aEasB3e.png[/img]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Xuk4XaN.gif[/img]
[size=3]Why settle for one look? Your flying buddy now [b]comes with four distinct visual variants[/b] to choose from, giving you [b]more variety and personality[/b] every time this colorful companion perches on your shoulder.[/size][/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZQlG47E.png[/img]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/fqBG1kU.gif[/img]
[size=3][b]﻿[/b][b]Junimo as a fairy?[/b] This mystical companion has been reimagined with a [b]fresh new look[/b]. Best of all, you can now [b]swap between any fairy texture you want regardless of which one originally appeared in your save file [/b]giving you the freedom to customize your fairy however you like.[/size][/center]

[center][font=Arial][size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size][/font][b]
[size=3]────────────[/size][size=3]✧[/size][size=3]──────[/size][size=3]──────[/size][/b]
[size=3][b]1.[/b] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional) if you haven't yet,﻿
[b]2.[/b] Download this mod, extract, and drop it inside your mods folder
[b]3.[/b] All done and you are ready to go!﻿
[b][color=#e69138]*[/color][/b] To [b]enable[/b] or [b]disable[/b] any retextures, run SMAPI once to generate a mod config file and [b]edit it manuall[/b]y or you can just [b]edit it in-game[/b] using the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/size]
